[Figure 1: Character reference — face, hair, body type, and clothing identity]

## CHARACTER (from Figure 1 — zero-tolerance deviation)
Subject: Figure 1's character, preserving exact facial features, hair color and style, skin tone, body proportions, and clothing appearance as shown in Figure 1. Do NOT modify or override any character attributes with text descriptions.

## SCENE
Standing in a blooming spring flower garden with cherry blossom trees, colorful seasonal flowers in full bloom, warm rustic garden setting. Light blue sky background, bright natural sunlight casting soft warm illumination on the scene.

## STYLE — Korean Spring Aesthetic Scrapbook Poster
- Base aesthetic: dreamy K-fashion portrait, Korean magazine editorial, cottagecore fashion, Pinterest aesthetic
- Scrapbook overlays: cute doodles, hand-drawn white hearts, smiley faces, stars, sparkles, rainbow
- Decorative elements: playful hand-lettered typography, Polaroid photo frame, tape stickers, white outline around the subject, floral-themed decorations
- Layout: scrapbook collage layout, Y2K scrapbook design, fashion mood board composition

## ATMOSPHERE & COLOR
Dreamy spring atmosphere, wholesome and lovely vibe. Soft pastel color palette (cream, powder blue, pale pink, lavender). Clean composition with subtle bokeh. Cute and charming mood.

## FUSION RULES
- Character identity: Figure 1 is the sole authority on all character attributes — lighting and color temperature on the character should adapt to Figure 1's original lighting
- Scene and style: text prompt is the authority on environment, decorations, and overall color grading
- Scrapbook overlays render ON TOP of the character/scene layer (decorative elements are the topmost visual layer)
- Color grading anchor: pastel palette governs the overall tone; Figure 1's character colors integrate into this palette naturally

## OUTPUT
Realistic photo base with scrapbook graphic overlay, aesthetic social media poster, Instagram reel cover style. Ultra-detailed, high quality, 8K masterpiece.

## NEGATIVE CONSTRAINTS
no mixed-style zones, no character feature drift from Figure 1, no facial morphing, no skin tone change, no clothing alteration, no hairstyle change, no style bleeding between scrapbook overlays and photo base, no oversaturated colors, no cluttered layout, no text rendering errors, no watermark

节点#11 RH_RhartImageG2ImageToImage
作用：调用 ImageG2 图生图接口：接收参考图与提示词参数，执行重绘/编辑生成并输出新的图像结果供后续保存或继续处理。
参数：
- prompt：当前值=[Figure 1: Character reference — face, hair, body…；作用：主编辑提示词，描述目标结果；范围：字符串，建议 1 ~ 2048 字符；默认：空字符串。
- aspectRatio：当前值=3:4；作用：控制画面宽高比，决定横竖构图和主体留白；范围：下拉枚举（如 16:9 / 9:16 / 3:4）；默认：auto。
- skip_error：当前值=False；作用：遇到单次接口报错时是否跳过并继续后续流程；范围：布尔值：true/false；默认：false。
- seed：当前值=1787579924；作用：随机种子，控制可复现性；范围：整数，常见 0 ~ 2^63-1；默认：0。
- resolution：当前值=randomize；作用：选择输出分辨率档位（清晰度越高，耗时和显存通常越高）；范围：预设尺寸下拉列表（如 720p / 1080p）；默认：720p（常见默认）。
- image1：当前值=来自 节点#12 LoadImage 的 `IMAGE` 输出；作用：接收上游图像输入（可为多张参考图）；范围：图像数据（连线输入）；默认：由上游节点输出决定。

节点#12 LoadImage
作用：加载参考图像，作为编辑与条件构建的视觉输入。
参数：
- image：当前值=9b9351a881c4e09514944453a669e8f0c887a0080f27e7aef…；作用：选择要加载的本地图片文件，作为参考图或后续上传素材；范围：当前工作目录可访问图像；默认：未选择。
- upload：当前值=image；作用：上传图片入口；用于把本地图片送入 `image` 文件列表；范围：IMAGEUPLOAD 控件；默认：空。
